## Hotels and rates for 1–11 September 2027

Finlandia 4* in Quito — 2 nights; La Floresta 3* in Baños — 2 nights; Casa del Suizo Lodge 4* — 2 nights; Termas de Papallacta 4* — 1 night; Fiesta 3* on Santa Cruz Island — 3 nights. Hotels may be replaced by others of a similar category.

| Accommodation | Price, USD per person |
|---|---:|
| Single | 4917 |
| Double | 4260 |
| Triple | 4157 |

You have an English-speaking guide on the mainland and in the Galápagos. Your first transfer in Quito is with an English-speaking driver; the final transfer from the hotel to Baltra Airport is with a Spanish-speaking assistant.

## Flights and the end of the tour

On day 8, you fly from the mainland to the Galápagos Islands on the agreed route via Quito or Guayaquil. Flights from Quito may stop in Guayaquil. On day 11, you fly back from Baltra to Quito or Guayaquil.

Flights are paid for separately from the tour price. As a guide, fares start at USD 575; Ada Tours calculates the exact price and suitable connections on request for your travel dates.

We recommend allowing at least four hours between your return from the islands and your international flight. An early international departure will require an extra night in Quito or Guayaquil. Extra nights on Santa Cruz or an extension to Isabela are available on request; they are outside the stated 11-day programme.
